properties.name: pos.tenant.kafka.enabled
properties.description: Publish tenant registry facts to tenant.events.v1 through the outbox and consume tenant.provisioned.

properties.name: pos.tenant.kafka.events-topic
properties.description: Topic for tenant registry facts (ADR-0062 section 7).

properties.name: pos.tenant.registry.api-secret
properties.description: Shared secret other services send as X-Tenant-Registry-Secret to GET /internal/v1/tenants (pos-tenancy-common RemoteTenantRegistry). Blank refuses every call.

properties.name: pos.tenant.outbox.poll-interval-ms
properties.description: Outbox drain poll interval in milliseconds.

properties.name: pos.tenant.outbox.send-timeout-ms
properties.description: Broker acknowledgement timeout per outbox row in milliseconds.

properties.name: pos.events.base-url
properties.description: Base URL of the pos-event-receiver API.

properties.name: pos.events.api-secret
properties.description: Shared secret used to authenticate event type registration requests.

properties.name: pos.security.base-url
properties.description: Base URL for permission registration against pos-security-service.

properties.name: pos.security.permission-registration.enabled
properties.description: Enable startup permission registration with pos-security-service.
